# YT-Trimmer — AI-Readable Summary
# https://yt-trimmer.com/llms.txt

## What is YT-Trimmer?
YT-Trimmer is a web-based video download and trimming platform. Users paste a video URL, set start/end trim points using a slider or manual time input, choose a format and quality, and download the processed file. No desktop software is required.

## Who is it for?
Content creators, students, researchers, social media managers, and anyone who needs to extract a specific clip from a video or download video/audio for offline use.

## Core features
- Download videos from YouTube and other supported platforms
- Trim video to an exact start/end time before downloading
- Download as MP4 (video) or MP3 (audio only)
- Quality options: up to 720p free, up to 4K with premium
- Video trimming with a precision slider and manual time input
- Download history for registered users (premium)
- No signup required for basic use

## Free vs Premium
Free tier: up to 720p quality, 24fps, MP4 and MP3 formats, video trimming. No download history.
Premium tier: up to 4K, high frame rates (60fps+), download history, priority processing, all formats.

## Premium plans (as of 2025)
- Weekly: $1 / 7 days
- Monthly: $3 / 30 days (most popular)
- 3 Months: $8 / 90 days (save 38%)
- 5 Months: $13 / 150 days (best value)

## Payment methods
Stripe (credit/debit cards), PayPal, Crypto, Easypaisa, Bank Transfer.
Manual payments (non-Stripe) require a screenshot proof and are approved by an admin within 24 hours.
Promo codes are available and can be redeemed on the pricing page.

## Privacy & security
Files are automatically deleted from the server after processing. YT-Trimmer does not retain videos. User passwords are hashed. No third-party tracking.

## FAQ
Q: Is YT-Trimmer free?
A: Yes. Basic use (up to 720p, trimming, MP4/MP3) is free with no account required.

Q: Do I need to sign up?
A: No. Free downloads work without an account. Accounts unlock download history and premium features.

Q: What platforms are supported?
A: YouTube is the primary platform. Other platforms may work depending on URL format.

Q: How fast is processing?
A: Most videos are processed within seconds. Longer clips may take a few minutes.

Q: Is it legal?
A: Downloading videos for personal, non-commercial use may be permitted under fair use in many regions. Users are responsible for complying with the terms of service of source platforms and applicable copyright law.

## Technical stack (for developers)
Frontend: React 18, Tailwind CSS, React Router v6
Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose
Payments: Stripe + manual payment flow
Authentication: JWT, bcrypt
File processing: yt-dlp, ffmpeg
